sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Shipment Tracking is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "My people haven't been able to access the cargo yet. However, if there's anything of value-- I mean of danger, we can't waste any time. All shipments had to be documented one way or another. Perhaps an itinerary or a cargo manifest would shed more light on the situation. You need to locate that piece of information. Look in the offices of key persons at the customs: directors, supervisors. If there is anything we might find, it should be there."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain the TerraGroup shipment lists on Customs
- Hand over the found information

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Therapist Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Pile of meds
"It will take some time for me to study these documents. Nevertheless, we will soon discover everything that is wrong with this shipment and what it contains. Along with a report from my specialists, we will receive comprehensive details."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| TerraGroup shipment report | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
| Company director's room key | 1 | Required | N/A | Key to the director's room on the second floor of the boiler building |

In this quest you have to find the TerraGroup shipment lists on Customs. They can be found in the director's room on the second floor of the boiler building. A Company director's room key is required to enter it. There are multiple spawns throughout the room.
